## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ### Run it on your own machine

**llama.cpp** · install: macOS / Linux `curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh` · Windows `irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex` · [other ways](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md) · Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead.

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~404.9GB
llama cli -hf unsloth/DeepSeek-TNG-R1T2-Chimera-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf unsloth/DeepSeek-TNG-R1T2-Chimera-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~713.3GB
llama cli -hf unsloth/DeepSeek-TNG-R1T2-Chimera-GGUF:Q8_0
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf unsloth/DeepSeek-TNG-R1T2-Chimera-GGUF:Q8_0
# 2-bit UD-IQ2_XXS · ~216.2GB
llama cli -hf unsloth/DeepSeek-TNG-R1T2-Chimera-GGUF:UD-IQ2_XXS
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf unsloth/DeepSeek-TNG-R1T2-Chimera-GGUF:UD-IQ2_XXS
```

**LM Studio** · install: [macOS / Windows / Linux](https://lmstudio.ai/download) · Open the app once before using the lms command.

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~404.9GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/DeepSeek-TNG-R1T2-Chimera-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~713.3GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/DeepSeek-TNG-R1T2-Chimera-GGUF@Q8_0 -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 2-bit UD-IQ2_XXS · ~216.2GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/DeepSeek-TNG-R1T2-Chimera-GGUF@UD-IQ2_XXS -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
```
